messages:
emma: Triage asked for a 14d retention exception for specific PCAPs. Can we approve a timeboxed flow?
lia: PCAPs contain PII and are large. We need strict gating.
oscar: They need packet context to repro the exploit; 7d was insufficient.
kai: Proposal: ticketed exception + JIT KMS unwrap via proxy, MFA, short unwrap window, no permanent unwrap role.
legal: Any extension must record justification; exports require redaction and legal review.
lia: Draft flow: tag object, create ticket (severity + justification), approver signs, proxy issues ephemeral unwrap token, audit event emitted. Exports run scrubber + DLP.
security-bot: Runbook stub published: https://internal.runbooks.company/pcap-jit (DRAFT).
oscar: Audit: emit a single composite `pcap:access:grant` event with ticket_id,user,role,file_ids,key_version,unwrap_until to keep SIEM index small.
kai: CLI sample: `redwood-kms-proxy grant --ticket 42 --files f1,f2 --mins 60 --mfa --reason "repro" --no-export`
lia: Add approver matrix: sec-triage lead for low, SOC mgr + legal for high/customer-impact.
emma: Emergency path: SOC lead can escalate with post-facto review within 24h.
kai: Will enforce concurrency limits (e.g., 3 active grants/user) and rewrap on CMK rotation.
security-bot: Action items: kai: proxy+CLI (3d), lia: approver matrix (2d), oscar: audit schema+dashboard (4d), legal: export checklist. Reconvene in 3 days.
